summary.text: Billy Bob Faulkingham is a Republican state representative from Maine House District 12 who is running for Maine State Senate District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A fisherman and U.S. Marine Corps Reserve veteran, he was elected House minority leader in November 2022 and was unable to file for re-election to the House because of term limits.

paragraphs.text: Billy Bob Faulkingham lives in Winter Harbor, Maine, and served in the United States Marine Corps Reserve from 1999 to 2002.
His career experience includes working as a fisherman.
Faulkingham won re-election to House District 12 in November 2024, defeating Democrat Norman Bamford, 61.1% to 38.9%.
He served on the Marine Resources Committee in the 2019–2020 and 2021–2022 sessions and was ranking member of the Rules and Business of the House Committee in 2023–2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, and faces independent candidate Aaron Dana in the general election.
